scope: Primary sources, exact inherited source pin, and three background texts for Quantum-Monitoring-Thresholds.

references.creator: GoGoKo699
references.title: Measurement-Geometry-Superadditivity
references.role: Exact same noisy-record channel, global one-use criterion, finite all-record repetition construction, and outer-coding implication. These are credited inherited ingredients.

references.title: Positivity and nonadditivity of quantum capacities using generalized erasure channels
references.role: General identity-plus-auxiliary gluing framework; its dephasing-complement example is not the full-rank classical-record channel.

references.title: Dephrasure channel and superadditivity of coherent information
references.role: Superadditivity and repetition-code precedent for a different flagged channel.

references.title: Improving quantum communication rates with permutation-invariant codes
references.role: Context for achievable-rate improvements with structured collective codes; distinct from the joint setting/error activation law.

references.title: The private classical capacity and quantum capacity of a quantum channel
references.role: Coherent-information coding theorem: a fixed positive finite inner block yields a positive asymptotic unassisted rate.

references.title: Randomly Monitored Quantum Codes
references.role: Ideal-record measurement thresholds in quantum codes; motivates the access-sensitive finite-readout-error question.

references.title: Weight of informativeness, state exclusion games and excludible information
references.role: Existing measurement resource weight. The sum of minimum effect eigenvalues is the maximal trivial-measurement fraction, not a newly defined monotone here.

references.title: Unlearning quantum information
references.role: Measurement-reversal probability governed by minimum singular values; supplies the existing smallest-eigenvalue structure.

references.title: Incompatibility of quantum channels
references.journal: Journal of Physics A: Mathematical and Theoretical
references.role: Channel self-compatibility and the equivalence of two-self-compatibility with antidegradability.

references.title: Quantum Doeblin Coefficients: Interpretations and Applications
references.role: Existing POVM noise content and its equality to the measurement-channel quantum Doeblin coefficient.

references.title: Compatible quantum correlations: Extension problems for Werner and isotropic states
references.role: Symmetric-extension compatibility and isotropic-state bounds underlying the standard finite-dimensional singlet-fraction ceiling.

references.title: A bound on the mutual information, and properties of entropy reduction, for quantum channels with inefficient measurements
references.role: Concavity and covariant Schur-concavity of entropy reduction. Its additive bound does not control the cost/entropy ratio uniformly near pure inputs.

references.title: Entropy reduction of quantum measurements
references.role: General entropy-reduction and measurement framework; background for homogeneous conditional entropy.

references.title: Bounds on Information Combining With Quantum Side Information
references.role: Quantum information-combining comparator; its independent binary-input XOR setting differs from the arbitrary-purity angular entropy ratio.

references.title: Conditional contraction coefficients and their applications to quantum networks
references.role: Current general conditional-contraction framework and standard extendibility bounds; not an evaluation of the setting/error frontier.

references.title: The Theory of Quantum Information
references.role: Rigorous background in channels, distance, entropy, entanglement, and capacity.
references.access_note: The author page provides a personal-use manuscript. Link to it; do not redistribute it.

references.title: Quantum Shannon Theory
references.role: Entropy, entanglement, measurements, coherent information, decoupling, and the coding theorem.
references.access_note: Version-pinned author chapter draft, made available for personal use; link rather than redistribute.

references.title: Quantum Information Theory
references.role: Conditional entropy, coherent information, data processing, quantum channel coding, and degradability.
references.version_note: The reference is the published second edition, not a later updated author draft.
